PHASE.NAME: Public Release Truth Readiness
PHASE.GOAL: Prepare the first public Linux/macOS release candidate by closing stale-version, package identity, installer fallback, MCP flag truth, no-active-phase, public-doc, license, and readiness-evidence gaps

PLANNED_WORK.step-1: Bump the release line to v2.4.0, avoid the crates.io syn package-name conflict, preserve the syn binary/library names, and point package metadata at the real repository.
PLANNED_WORK.step-2: Keep release artifact install as the preferred path while adding locked source fallback for CI source refs, existing release tags, and default pre-tag main builds.
PLANNED_WORK.step-3: Add release freshness gates and pin hosted fresh-install smoke to the workflow commit through SYN_INSTALL_SOURCE_REF.
PLANNED_WORK.step-4: Remove unimplemented MCP HTTP/LSP flags from public help and keep syn mcp stdio-only.
PLANNED_WORK.step-5: Report no active phase when all phase shards are done, and preserve that state during refresh.
PLANNED_WORK.step-6: Expand parity tests for package identity, release freshness, installer fallback, commit-pinned fresh install, and MCP help truth.
PLANNED_WORK.step-7: Clarify public privacy/token-savings claims, ship full Apache-2.0 license text, and update changelog/readiness evidence.

ACCEPTANCE.CHECK: Cargo package is synapse-agent while lib/bin remain syn; installer default is v2.4.0.
Release freshness guard blocks stale tags and exact tag drift before release publishing.
Fresh install CI uses the workflow commit source ref instead of silently reinstalling an older tag.
Default installer does not fail in the pre-tag release-candidate window; it can build main when the default tag is pending.
syn mcp public help exposes no HTTP, bind, or LSP flags until those transports exist.
MyGRACE status and refresh preserve a true no-active-phase state after all phase shards are done.
Public docs no longer claim unmeasured token-saving percentages or imply Synapse sends no data through configured AI providers.

PHASE.LOCAL_GATE: cargo fmt --all; cargo test --all-targets; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; bash scripts/ci.sh; refresh --json drift=0; verify --ci; review --mode full --ci
PHASE.HOSTED_GATE: Required before publishing the public release tag: push this commit, wait for GitHub CI fresh-install Linux/macOS source-ref smoke to pass, then create v2.4.0 and wait for the release workflow to pass on the exact tag.
